verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions zero-data-retention handling for uploaded documents, SOC 2 attestation, or HIPAA/BAA options. The only related evidence is on-prem/single-container deployment that keeps data in the customer's environment, plus a reference to a Trust Center. Those are adjacent deployment options, not the zero-retention and compliance guarantees the story asks for.

support.subject: As a data engineer, uploaded documents get zero-retention handling with SOC 2 and HIPAA options, so I can process contracts and medical records
